scope.summary: Suite-wide conformance harness proving [STU-CON-007](d): for EVERY Studio command producing visual output, the result is inspectable through the headless StudioRenderHarness render capture (MT-008) + Argus (MT-547), with before/after evidence, no foreground UI, and no focus steal. Enumerates all visual-output command_ids; runs each and asserts a render-harness pixel capture (real-GPU) or AccessKit-tree/state assertion (headless fallback) plus an Argus author_id inspection is produced. Fails closed on any visual-output command with no render/Argus proof path.
acceptance_criteria: every visual-output command render-harness/Argus verifiable with before/after evidence; headless-safe; no focus steal
expected_tests: live: every visual-output command_id yields render-harness capture (real-GPU) or AccessKit fallback (headless) + Argus inspection + before/after evidence
negative: a visual command with no render/Argus path fails the gate

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Models cannot deterministically verify visual edits (photos/masks/layouts); STU-CON-007(d) unenforced.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
